# Fanju

> Fanju 是面向全球华人年轻人的同城小桌饭局平台，帮助用户通过一顿饭认识同频的人。

## Safety boundaries

Fanju is not a dating app, not a random WeChat group, and does not guarantee friendship, dating, fundraising, or business outcomes. Fanju emphasizes public venues, clear topics, transparent costs, real profiles, and personal boundaries.
